## v0.1.2

- Updated skill description for improved clarity and bilingual presentation in SKILL.md.
- Refined and shortened trigger phrases, consolidated and clarified language for a broader audience.
- No functional code changes; documentation only.

daily-tongjian v0.1.1

- Added a detailed README.md documenting usage, workflow, output requirements, progress management, and delivery options.
- No changes to code or feature logic in this release.

- Initial release of Daily Tongjian (每日通鉴) skill for reading Zizhi Tongjian, with automatic progress tracking across all 294 volumes.
- Delivers each lecture in three steps by default: complete written transcript, illustrated image, and voice narration, unless user requests otherwise.
- Includes classical Chinese text, fluent translation (Chinese or English), and in-depth commentary; ensures all sections are sufficiently detailed.
- Progress and preferences are managed via command-line scripts, with support for language selection, skipping, and review.
- Designed for flexible delivery: can be triggered manually by keywords or integrated with scheduled tasks and specific channels.
